detail.longDescription: I'm using Nuxt 4 and want to make use of auto-imports. Given a TS type import { z } from "zod"; export type MyType = z.infer<typeof mySchema>; I tried the following locations ./app/utils/MyType.ts ./app/types/MyType.ts (although the types dir is not mentioned in the Nuxt docs, just a try) When building the app and trying to use the type inside a Vue file like so <script setup lang="ts"> function x (y: MyType) { } </script> I'm getting the error 'MyType' refers to a value, but is being used as a type here. Did you mean 'typeof MyType'?ts-plugin(2749) How do I have to export types so they get picked up by auto-imports? Nuxt 4.6.x and above: Auto-imports from ./app/types/MyType.ts seem to work with the upcoming release of Nuxt 4.6
